title: Spaghetti Fettuccine with Egyptian Flair
description: A twist on the classic spaghetti dish, infused with the bold flavors of Egypt and a touch of indulgence.

ingredients.name: Parmesan Cheese
ingredients.notes: Grated for a sharp, salty flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Season with salt to balance flavors

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground for a peppery kick

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a separate pan, melt the butter over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the heavy cream to the pan and stir to combine, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until it thickens slightly.
Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the ground cumin and smoked paprika to the sauce and stir to combine.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked spaghetti and add it to the sauce, tossing to combine.
Serve hot, topped with additional grated Parmesan cheese if desired.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro for added color and freshness.
